name: Default
shortDescription: Video conversion server for VERT, built in Rust on FFmpeg, running in CPU software-encoding mode behind HTTPS.

alerts.message: vertd is an API with no web UI and no authentication. Open VERT, go to Settings > Video conversion server, set Instance to Custom and enter this app's https URL. Anyone who knows the URL can submit conversions.
No GPU is passed to the container, so videos are encoded on the CPU with software encoders, which is slower than hardware acceleration.
